text: Who are the best luxury real estate agencies in Sydney? Give me a shortlist of specific prestige property agencies with reasons.

result.keyword: Who are the best luxury real estate agencies in Sydney? Give me a shortlist of specific prestige property agencies with reasons.

items.markdown:
Sydney’s premier luxury real estate agencies include [Sydney Sotheby's International Realty](https://sydneysothebysrealty.com/), [Ray White Double Bay](https://raywhitedoublebay.com/), [Bradfield BadgerFox](https://www.bradfieldbadgerfox.com.au/) , and [Pillinger](https://www.pillinger.com/) . These elite agencies dominate Sydney's high-end prestige market, specifically across the Eastern Suburbs and Lower North Shore.[[1]](https://www.pillinger.com/buy/)[[2]](https://www.realestate.com.au/agency/sydney-sothebys-international-realty-double-bay-TCMLHR)[[3]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHBIaCgNwdnESE0Nnd3ZaeTh4TW1oc2VUQXdjV3cYCg)[[4]](https://www.realestate.com.au/agency/bradfield-badgerfox-double-bay-XBBDOU)

### Sydney Sotheby’s International Realty

- **Focus** : Global luxury network alignment, elite harbourside estates, and high-end penthouses.
- **Why them** : Backed by a world-renowned international brand, they excel at connecting local trophy assets in suburbs like Vaucluse, Point Piper, and Rose Bay with ultra-high-net-worth domestic and international buyers.[[1]](https://www.sothebysrealty.com/eng/sales/sydney-sw-aus)[[2]](https://www.realestate.com.au/agency/sydney-sothebys-international-realty-double-bay-TCMLHR)

### Ray White Double Bay

- **Focus** : High-volume luxury transactions and dominant Eastern Suburbs market share.
- **Why them** : Consistently ranked as a top international office within the broader Ray White network, they boast unmatched local data, deep-pocketed buyer databases, and high-profile agents who regularly handle record-breaking mega-sales.[[1]](https://raywhitedoublebay.com/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHBIaCgNwdnESE0Nnd3ZaeTh4TW1oc2VUQXdjV3cYCg)

### Bradfield BadgerFox

- **Focus** : Boutique luxury sales, heritage properties, and premier residential apartments.
- **Why them** : Operating out of Double Bay, directors like Bob Guth and Alexander George bring decades of specialized prestige negotiation and discreet, relationship-driven client service across Bellevue Hill and Darling Point.[[1]](https://www.bradfieldbadgerfox.com.au/properties-for-sale)[[2]](https://www.realestate.com.au/agency/bradfield-badgerfox-double-bay-XBBDOU)

### Pillinger

- **Focus** : Ultra-prestige waterfront architectural homes and private, confidential transactions.
- **Why them** : Led by Brad Pillinger , the agency frequently secures listings for Sydney’s most expensive trophy streets (such as Wolseley Road in Point Piper and Victoria Road in Bellevue Hill), known for hyper-targeted and private marketing strategies.[[1]](https://www.pillinger.com/buy/)

If you are looking to buy or sell, tell me **which suburb** and **price bracket** you are targeting so I can recommend the **most relevant lead agent** from these firms.
